company.shortDescription: Fountain9 is an AI based demand sensing and dynamic replenishment service.
company.description: Fountain9 offers predictive inventory planning and optimization solution for CPG and retail. Our flagship product, Kronoscope uses AI to accurately predict future inventory imbalances which lead to out of stock situations or wastage, and also recommends best ways of minimizing their impact.
